prayers.name: Breath of Vulcatrix
prayers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the Damage characteristic of the target’s **Roaring Fyrestream** is 3 instead of D3.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Drothkeepers Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Drothkeepers Magmadroth^^** wholly within 12" of them to be a target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
